support_claim: Registry row 11847201 and billing invoices both name Helion Robotics Limited, and commercial notes explicitly state that these channels refer to the same legal entity.

propositions.proposition: Company registry row 11847201 records the legal name HELION ROBOTICS LIMITED as an active company in England and Wales.
propositions.relevance: Grounds the right referent registry:11847201 to the legal name Helion Robotics Limited.

propositions.proposition: Billing invoices carry the billed name Helion Robotics Limited.
propositions.relevance: Grounds the left referent billing:Helion Robotics Limited to the name used on invoices.

propositions.proposition: Commercial notes state that invoices and Companies House both use Helion Robotics Limited and that this is the same legal entity.
propositions.relevance: Explicitly links the billing channel (invoices) and the registry channel (Companies House) as referring to one legal entity, bridging billing:Helion Robotics Limited and registry:11847201.

propositions.proposition: Commercial notes state that Helion Robotics Ltd is the CRM operating name while invoices and Companies House use Helion Robotics Limited.
propositions.relevance: Confirms that the Limited-form name used in billing and registry records denotes the operative legal entity rather than an alternate naming variant.

propositions.proposition: Commercial notes identify Helion Industrial Systems Ltd as a different company with no current MSA.
propositions.relevance: Distinguishes a similarly named counterparty from the candidate pair, reducing risk of conflating distinct Helion-named entities.
